snippet.title: Game With Balls - Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
There is now a release date for Game With Balls! 27th of January 2026 the game will be available on Steam!

You can already wishlist or try the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3745250/Game_With_Balls/
